---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a config option, driver, or packaging change
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Description

A clear description of the change you'd like (e.g. enable a driver, a config
option, or a packaging improvement).

## Config Detail

- Config symbol(s): (e.g. `CONFIG_DRM_I915`)
- Built-in (`=y`) or module (`=m`)?
- Hardware / use case that needs it:

## Use Case

Why is this needed? What does it enable or fix?

## Impact

Does it affect image size, boot, or the low-latency profile? Does it risk any
boot-critical option (UEFI, root filesystem, block/initramfs)?

## Alternatives Considered

How does void-packages / upstream handle it? Config-only vs out-of-tree patch?

## Additional Context

Any other information or references.
